title: Очарованный странник
author: Лесков Н.С.
blurb: A huge monk on a boat tells his fellow passengers how he got there: a coachman, a horse doctor, a captive among the Tatars, a soldier, and now this.

title: Бесприданница
author: Островский А.Н.
blurb: A beautiful girl with no dowry agrees to marry a petty official, and then the man who abandoned her comes back to town.

title: Тимур и его команда
author: Гайдар А.П.
blurb: In a summer village outside Moscow a band of boys secretly does the heavy work for the families of men away at the front, and the local toughs try to stop them.

title: Аленький цветочек
author: Аксаков С.Т.
blurb: A merchant's youngest daughter asks for nothing but a scarlet flower, and her father picks one from a garden that belongs to someone.

title: Конёк-Горбунок
author: Ершов П.П.
blurb: The youngest and silliest of three brothers catches a mare and is given a small humpbacked horse, which turns out to be the best friend a fool ever had.

title: Двенадцать
author: Блок А.А.
blurb: Twelve Red Guardsmen march through a blizzard in revolutionary Petrograd, and someone is walking ahead of them in the snow.

title: Дьяволиада
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A clerk at the Match Supply Depot is sacked over a misread signature, and chases the official who signed it through a Moscow that will not hold still.

title: Роковые яйца
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A zoologist finds a ray that makes living things grow at monstrous speed, and a state farm takes it away from him to save the country's chickens.

title: Записки юного врача
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A doctor of twenty-three, a month out of university, is sent alone to a country hospital forty versts from the railway and learns his trade on whoever is carried through the door.

title: Морфий
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: The notebooks of a young country doctor who began with a quarter-syringe against a pain in the stomach, left to the colleague who reads them after his death.

title: Записки на манжетах
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Cuffs written on in the Caucasus and in Moscow: a writer with typhus, no money and no papers, talking his way from one office to the next.

title: Тайному другу
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: An unfinished letter to a friend about how he came to write, and the first form of what later became Театральный роман.

title: Ханский огонь
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A prince's palace, now a museum, is shown to day trippers by the old servant who stayed on with it, and one visitor in dark glasses knows the rooms too well.

title: Похождения Чичикова
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Gogol's Chichikov wakes up in Soviet Moscow, registers himself as a citizen, and finds the new institutions even easier to rob than the old.

title: Красная корона
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: From a room he is not allowed to leave, a man writes to his mother about the brother he watched ride away and did not call back.

title: № 13. Дом Эльпит-Рабкоммуна
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A grand Moscow apartment house, requisitioned and packed to the attics, burns down because no one is permitted to light a stove.

title: Китайская история
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A Chinese man alone in Moscow with no language, no papers and no bread is taken in by a machine-gun detachment.

title: Налёт
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Two sentries on a railway line in the freezing dark, and the raid that comes for them.

title: Я убил
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: At the end of an evening among doctors, one of them answers the question of whether he has ever killed a man.

title: Псалом
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A knock at the door that sounds like a rat scratching, the small boy from along the corridor who has come to visit, and the mother who follows him.

title: Самогонное озеро
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: For a quarter of an hour the corridor of the communal flat is quiet enough to read in, and then the neighbours come home with what they have been distilling.

title: Богема
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: How the author got through the winter of 1920 in Vladikavkaz by writing a revolutionary play in three days.

title: В ночь на 3-е число
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A night in Kiev as the city changes hands, taken from a novel he never finished.

title: Необыкновенные приключения доктора
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A doctor's civil-war notebook in fragments: mobilised, sent south, and moved about the country by other people's armies.

title: Киев-город
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A native's sketch of Kiev after the civil war — its hills and churches, its wrecked bridges, and a city that changed hands more times than anyone could count.

title: Грядущие перспективы
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: An article written from the White south in 1919: the war will be paid for, and the bill will fall on the people who did not start it.

title: Арифметика
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A general runs up six flights to tell the pretender to the Russian throne that the restoration has begun, and they sit down to do the arithmetic of it.

title: Библифетчик
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: At a railway station the man who runs the reading room also runs the beer counter, and his customers cannot always say which of the two they came for.

title: Был май
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A fine May, the lane where the theatre stands, and a man whose heart drops every time a car sounds its horn.

title: В кафе
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A café in a town behind the front: a filthy floor, a fog of tobacco, a trio playing something rowdy, and a great many civilians in no hurry to be anywhere.

title: В театре Зимина
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A reporter's notes from the railwaymen's jubilee at the Zimin theatre — greetings read from the platform, Kalinin made an honorary member, and a model carriage wheeled on at the end.

title: Вода жизни
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A tarpaulin-covered cart creeps up to the railway shop at a snowbound station, and the whole settlement has worked out what is under it before it is unloaded.

title: Воспаление мозгов
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Nine kopecks in one trouser pocket, an asphalt-melting afternoon, and a brain going soft in the heat — dedicated, with feeling, to the editors of every weekly magazine.

title: Воспоминание…
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Everyone has a memory of Vladimir Ilyich; this one involves a written application, Krupskaya's threadbare jacket, and the room that came of them.

title: Египетская мумия
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Two union men on a trip to Leningrad go looking for the wholesome recreation the Labour Code entitles them to, and find an Egyptian mummy.

title: Золотые корреспонденции Ферапонта Ферапонтовича Капорцева
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: The dispatches of a provincial worker-correspondent, printed exactly as sent apart from the spelling: the fireproof American house, and whatever else Blagodatsk has to report.

title: Как он сошёл с ума
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A doctor comes to the padded cell of a village schoolmaster, who greets him with a song and is perfectly willing to explain how he got there.

title: Каэнпе и капе
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A commission sits with a pile of applications, a provincial schoolmistress in men's boots is called in, and the questions turn on what the initials stand for.

title: Летучий голландец
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A patient's diary in entries of a line or two, from the first night of coughing to the sanatorium he is sent to.

title: Ноября 7-го дня
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Moscow in the two days before the anniversary of the revolution: red bulbs going up behind the shop windows, and the square outside the Soviet being made ready.

title: Остерегайтесь подделок!
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Émigré editors decide that their manifesto from the Russian workers was not convincing enough, and set about producing a better one.

title: Паршивый тип
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: By the statistics, two people in every thousand are geniuses; a locksmith announces to his wife that his resources are exhausted and that he has had an idea.

title: Площадь на колёсах
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: The diary of a man with no flat in Moscow: three nights in somebody's bath, two on a gas stove, and a growing collection of fines.

title: Повестка с государем императором
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A worker spells his way aloud through a postal notice and finds himself reading out the Emperor's name day, from a form nobody thought to reprint.

title: Праздник с сифилисом
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: In a village reading hut on the eighth of March the local medical assistant arrives to give the holiday lecture, and the subject he has chosen is syphilis.

title: Птицы в мансарде
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Spring sun on the worst courtyard in Moscow, across the road from the Rumyantsev museum, and what is going on in the garret above it.

title: Рабочий город-сад
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: How a garden city for workers came to be built outside Moscow — the idea three factories had in 1914, and the day the first stone was laid.

title: Развратник
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: A pointsman mentions to his superior that he is in a common-law marriage, and is told that he has always had the look of a debauchee.

title: Ревизор с вышибанием
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Gogol's Government Inspector as played at a railway club, with the committee, the audience and the throwing-out of a member all written into the cast list.

title: Самоцветный быт
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Letters out of the provinces, printed as received: the master who came to the Women's Day meeting drunk, and a cure for shyness.

title: Советская инквизиция
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: An article from 1919 on the Cheka's months in Kiev, and the executions that never reached the published lists.

title: Четыре портрета
author: Булгаков М.А.
blurb: Dinner for four in the new Moscow, where every person at the table is a former something.

title: Цемент
author: Гладков Ф.В.
_note: Original 1925 text, set from the scan of Ф. Гладков, Собрание сочинений, т. II: Цемент. «Земля и Фабрика», Москва—Ленинград, 1926 (второе издание). Not the text Gladkov revised from 1930 onward, which is what the online copies carry.
blurb: A Red Army soldier comes home to a dead cement works on the Black Sea coast and sets about restarting it — and finds his wife, his daughter and the Party all changed in his absence.
